name: pipeline-long-roundtrip-fees
description: Single LONG round trip with 0.1% fee on both sides per the canonical contract (FeeLeg.RECEIVED): all-in buy@100, sell@110, half of 365.25d apart. Pins the both-side fee math. Note: metrics.cagr documents the value over the half-year the signals span (a window under one year is not annualized, so it is the plain return 0.0978011) but is asserted by neither harness — a single yield gives first==last timestamp, where CAGR=0; a multi-trade pipeline fixture would exercise it.
